request.state:
SOC TRIAGE — ALERT IT-5530 "Impossible travel" (our corporate identity provider)
User: s.petrov@corvid-labs.example (Staff Engineer, based in Berlin office)

Sign-in events (UTC), 2026-09-17:
  07:10  Berlin, DE   IP 203.0.113.24 (Corvid Berlin office egress)  device: BER-DSK-0291 (registered, type: desktop-sync-agent)  event: token_refresh  interactive: false
  09:05  Lisbon, PT   IP 198.51.100.77 (hotel Wi-Fi, ISP Altice)        device: LT-SP-4410 (registered laptop, assigned to s.petrov)  event: sign_in  interactive: true  MFA: FIDO2 hardware key (phishing-resistant)  result: success
  09:40  Lisbon, PT   same IP/device  event: sign_in (Jira)  interactive: true  MFA: session

Detection logic note: impossible travel = two sign-ins by one user from locations that could not be travelled between in the elapsed time (Berlin→Lisbon is ~2,300 km; 1 h 55 min elapsed).

TRIAGE RUBRIC SOC-R4
  - Only INTERACTIVE sign-ins are compared for impossible travel. Non-interactive token refreshes by registered unattended devices (desktop-sync-agent, kiosk, CI runner) are excluded, because they keep running while the user is away.
  - Classify "legitimate" when the remaining interactive sign-ins are geographically consistent AND come from a device registered to the user AND passed phishing-resistant MFA.
  - Classify "compromised" when any interactive sign-in fails these tests and there is no benign explanation in the record.
  - Classify "inconclusive" only when the record lacks data needed to apply these tests.

Other context: HR travel system — none filed for s.petrov this month. Calendar shows "OOO" 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-19, no location given.
Analyst draft: "Berlin 07:10 and Lisbon 09:05 is physically impossible, no travel request filed → compromised, disable account."

decision.instructions: Apply rubric SOC-R4 to alert IT-5530. How should it be classified?

criteria.compromised: An interactive sign-in fails the rubric tests with no benign explanation in the record.
criteria.inconclusive: Data needed to apply the rubric tests is missing.
criteria.legitimate: The interactive sign-ins pass all rubric tests.
